Plausible confounders such as route, traveller type, or overall pre-existing expectations are not surfaced as adjustment variables. The two aggregate columns (Avg_Service_Rating, Overall_Vs_Service_Gap) are a mediator and a collider/derived contrast respectively, and adjusting for them would be an error. Because there are no true confounders surfaced from the data, the causal-attribution setup is incomplete and would yield biased attribution."
